5 تعظّم [He made himself to appear great, big, or large: as is indicated by an explanation of the word رُفَاعَة in the S, in art. رفع. ―
-b2- And hence,] He magnified himself; or behaved proudly, haughtily, or insolently; as also ↓ استعظم ; (S, Msb, K;) [and so ↓ تعاظم : ―
-b3- whence one says, تعظّم عَنْهُ and عنه ↓ تعاظم , both of which occur in the K, the former in art. ابه in explanation of تَأَبَّهَ عَنْ كَذَا, and the latter in art. جل in explanation of تَجَالَّ عَنْهُ; both meaning He held himself above it, disdained it, or was disdainful of it.] ―
-b4- [تَعَظَّمَ ٱللّٰهُ and ↓ تَعَاظَمَ may be best rendered Incomparable in greatness, or majesty, is God.] ＝
-A2- See also 10.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
